info.name: Sentinel production API — individual endpoint tests
info.description: Generated from docs/openapi.json. Run requests individually. Write requests change production data. Examples require real IDs, account values, reset/invitation tokens, and browser-generated push subscription keys. Login saves its token locally in collection variables. Do not export or commit populated secrets.
